name: Hostage Taker
oracle_text: When this creature enters, exile another target creature or artifact until this creature leaves the battlefield. You may cast that card for as long as it remains exiled, and mana of any type can be spent to cast that spell.
blocked_sentences: You may cast that card for as long as it remains exiled, and mana of any type can be spent to cast that spell.

needs.what: a flag on exile's playable permission (e.g. `playable_cast_only: true`) that grants permission to CAST the exiled card only, never to PLAY it as a land: legality.py's exiled-land walk must skip such a card, so an exiled artifact land (Seat of the Synod, Darksteel Citadel) taken by Hostage Taker cannot be played with a land drop and stays exiled until Hostage Taker leaves
needs.why_existing_wont_do: `exile` with `until_leaves`, `playable: "while_exiled"` and `any_type: true` says everything else exactly (the return is the usual `leaves_battlefield` + `put_onto_battlefield` from `exiled_with: self`), but the `playable` permission is a PLAY permission: legality.py offers every exiled card with `playable_by == pid` as a land play, so an exiled artifact land could be played as a land drop, which the printed 'cast' forbids. No key in op_options (`playable_*`, `limit`) narrows the permission to casting, and narrowing the target to nonland would drop legal targets instead
